description:

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.
  

  

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Commercial \& Investment Bank, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5\+ years applied experience ( NAMR/APAC – India/ LATAM/ Hong Kong)

* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
* Proficient in all aspects of the Software Development Life Cycle

* Practical cloud native experience

title: .Net FS Angular - Specialist I - Software Engineering
description:
**Role description**  

Fullstack Specialist Software Engineer Experience: 10\+ Years Role Type: Full\-time Level: Senior / Specialist Technology Focus: .NET \| Angular \| React \| Microservices \| SQL Server \| CICD \| AI\-Assisted Engineering About the Role We are looking for a Strong Fullstack Specialist Software Engineer with 10\+ years of experience to join our engineering team and contribute to the design, development, modernization, and support of highly scalable enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on technical specialist with strong expertise in .NET/C\#, ASP.NET Core, Angular and/or React, along with proven experience building microservices, REST APIs, event\-driven systems, and high\-performance database solutions. This requires someone who can work across the full technology stack, understand complex business requirements, make sound technical decisions, troubleshoot production issues, and contribute to engineering standards and architecture. The candidate should also be comfortable leveraging AI\-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, testing, documentation, and software delivery. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Key Responsibilities Fullstack Software Development • Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise applications using C\#, .NET / ASP.NET Core. • Develop modern, responsive frontend applications using Angular and/or React. • Build reusable, maintainable, and testable components across the frontend and backend. • Develop and integrate RESTful APIs and GraphQL APIs where appropriate. • Implement secure, high\-performance, and backward\-compatible APIs. • Participate in technical design, code reviews, refactoring, and engineering improvements. Microservices \& Distributed Systems • Design and develop microservice\-based applications aligned with business capabilities and bounded contexts. • Apply Clean Architecture, SOLID, Dependency Injection, and other modern software engineering principles. • Design service\-to\-service communication using REST, gRPC, and asynchronous messaging where appropriate. • Work with RabbitMQ or similar messaging platforms to implement event\-driven architectures. • Implement patterns such as: o Idempotency o Outbox Pattern o Saga / distributed transaction patterns o Retry and exponential backoff o Dead Letter Queues o Circuit breakers and resilience patterns • Design systems for scalability, availability, fault tolerance, and graceful degradation. Database \& Data Access • Design and optimize SQL Server databases, queries, stored procedures, and indexes. • Demonstrate strong understanding of: o Clustered and non\-clustered indexes o Query execution plans o Parameter sniffing o Pagination strategies o Query optimization o Transactions and locking o Database performance troubleshooting • Work with Entity Framework Core and/or Dapper. • Design efficient data\-access strategies based on application requirements and performance characteristics. Frontend Engineering • Build scalable frontend applications using Angular and/or React. • Strong understanding of component\-based architecture, state management, routing, forms, API integration, and frontend security. • For Angular, experience with modern capabilities such as: o Standalone components o Signals o Lazy loading o Modern control flow o Change detection optimization o SSR/hydration concepts • For React, experience with: o Hooks o Component architecture o State management o Performance optimization o Lazy loading o Modern rendering patterns • Ensure applications are performant, accessible, maintainable, and responsive. API Design \& Integration • Design APIs with clear contracts, appropriate versioning, authentication, authorization, validation, error handling, and logging. • Ensure backward compatibility and minimize breaking changes. • Implement API contract testing and automated compatibility checks where appropriate. • Understand API lifecycle management, deprecation, documentation, and consumer impact. Performance, Scalability \& Reliability • Design applications capable of handling high transaction volumes and increasing workloads. • Apply: o Distributed caching using Redis o Asynchronous programming o Connection pooling o Pagination o Database optimization o Horizontal scaling o Queue\-based processing o Resilience patterns • Understand .NET ThreadPool behavior and thread starvation. • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks across application, database, network, and external dependencies. Observability \& Production Engineering • Implement modern observability using logs, metrics, and distributed traces. • Experience with OpenTelemetry and one or more APM/observability platforms such as: o Dynatrace o Application Insights o Datadog o New Relic o Prometheus/Grafana • Implement correlation and trace IDs across distributed services. • Contribute to production stability, monitoring, incident resolution, and preventive actions. DevOps \& Continuous Delivery • Work closely with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines. • Integrate automated: o Unit tests o Integration tests o Code quality checks o Security scanning o API contract validation o Deployment verification • Support modern deployment strategies such as rolling, blue\-green, feature flags, and automated rollback. • Understand engineering metrics such as DORA metrics and use them to improve delivery effectiveness. AI\-Assisted Software Engineering • Actively leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and other enterprise\-approved AI assistants throughout the SDLC. • Use AI for: o Code generation and refactoring o Unit and test\-case generation o Code review o Requirements analysis o Documentation o Troubleshooting and RCA o API development o Technical design exploration • Develop and use project\-specific AI instructions/context to improve the quality and consistency of AI\-generated output. • Validate AI\-generated code for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and business rules. • Promote responsible and governed adoption of AI within engineering teams. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ Required Technical Skills Backend • 10\+ years of software development experience • Strong hands\-on experience with: o C\# o .NET / ASP.NET Core o REST APIs o Entity Framework Core o Dapper o Dependency Injection o Async/Await o SOLID principles o Clean Architecture • Strong microservices and distributed\-system experience. Frontend Strong experience with Angular and/or React, including: • Component architecture • State management • API integration • Routing • Forms • Performance optimization • Security • Testing • Modern frontend development practices Strong preference for candidates with hands\-on experience in both Angular and React. Database • Strong SQL Server experience • Query optimization • Indexing • Stored procedures • Execution plans • Transactions • Performance tuning • EF Core / Dapper Messaging • RabbitMQ or equivalent messaging technology • Event\-driven architecture • Retry mechanisms • DLQ/DLX • Idempotency • Outbox Pattern • Asynchronous processing Cloud / DevOps • CI/CD • Git • Automated testing • Containerization / Docker • Cloud\-native application concepts • Deployment and rollback strategies Observability • OpenTelemetry • Distributed tracing • Metrics and structured logging • Dynatrace / Application Insights / Datadog / equivalent APM AI • Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools • GitHub Copilot or equivalent • AI\-assisted coding, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, or code review • Understanding of responsible AI usage within software engineering Engineering \& Problem\-Solving Skills The candidate should demonstrate: • Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. • Strong understanding of software design principles and architectural trade\-offs. • Ability to identify performance, scalability, security, and reliability risks.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Frontend–React)
description:
**Who we are.**

  

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all\-in\-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

  

This role will help build the customer\-facing surfaces that define the Bluehost experience for millions of small businesses. We're scaling fast and rebuilding as we go: new architectural patterns, AI\-native features, and a bar for craft that keeps rising. This is a role for a builder who owns outcomes end\-to\-end, moves ideas from concept to production in days rather than sprints, and wants to help redefine how our front\-end systems get built and shipped.  



**What you’ll do** **\&** **how you’ll make** **your mark.**

* Build scalable, responsive, and high\-performance web applications.
* Convert UI/UX designs into clean and interactive front\-end experiences.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to deliver features end\-to\-end.
* Improve application performance, accessibility, and usability across devices and browsers.
* Write clean, reusable, and maintainable code following best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and deployment activities.
* Contribute ideas that improve user experience, engineering processes, and product quality.
* Stay updated with modern front\-end technologies, AI trends, and industry best practices.

 **Who you are \&** **what you’ll need** **to succeed.**

* 5\-8 years of experience in frontend development preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging technologies, especially AI\-driven applications.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Good communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Attention to detail with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Passion for building intuitive and user\-friendly digital experiences.
* Ability to manage priorities and deliver within deadlines.

 **Tech Knowledge Required**

* Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
* Hands\-on experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React.
* Deep understanding of React concepts including Hooks, Context API, component lifecycle, state management, routing, and reusable component architecture.
* Experience with responsive and mobile\-first web development.
* Familiarity with REST APIs and asynchronous programming.
* Knowledge of version control systems like Git.
* Unit \& automation testing using Jest, React Testing Library, and Cypress or any other lib; integrated with CI/CD for continuous quality assurance.
* Experience using AI\-powered developer tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI coding assistants to accelerate development and debugging workflows.
* Experience with front\-end build tools and package managers such as Webpack, Vite, npm, or Yarn.
* Understanding state management libraries like Redux or Zustand.
* Familiarity with testing frameworks and debugging tools.
* Basic understanding of web performance optimization and accessibility standards.
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and Agile/Scrum development practices is a plus.

 **Why you’ll love us.**

* **We’ve evolved:** We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work\-from\-home, hybrid, or work\-from\-the\-office environment.
* Work\-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* **We celebrate one another’s differences:** We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20\+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.
* **We care about you:** At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi\-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* **Where can we take you?** We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost \#OTOD!

  

\#Bluehost \#LI\-BB1
